title: ready-05: agent contract, agent status in the pane row, and sounds
summary: One contract for agent programs (Claude Code, Codex, pi built in; plugins add more); status from their hooks shown in the pane row; sounds on changes.
description:
Decisions 13, 19, 20 in `~/projects/heca-pro/docs/decisions.md`. Replaces the status-and-sounds part of F008 (`agent-integration/agent-integration-plan.md`, P048 tasks T173 "Agent status display" and T175 "Transition sounds", both deferred) — reuse its research on hooks, rewrite the design against today's code. Rooms, orchestration and agent-comms are heca-pro, not here.

## Current state
- `heca-core/src/backend/terminal/osc.rs:4` — the escape-code reader knows only prompt start, command start, pre-exec, program, command finished, cwd.
- `heca-core/src/runtime.rs:72` — `PaneRuntime` has no agent state. Process status and pane rows: `heca/src/app/process_monitor.rs`, `heca/src/providers/workspaces/pane_row.rs`.

## Goal
- **One agent contract** any agent program implements: recognise it (by program), start it (with whatever it needs to report status), read its status. Claude Code, Codex and pi are built-in implementations of the same contract a plugin would write — code never branches on a program's name.
- Status set: working, waiting for input, waiting for permission, finished, error, compacting, subagent running — open to more.
- Status sources: Claude Code hooks printing a notification escape code (added through `--settings`, the user's own settings untouched), Codex's own notification codes, a small pi extension writing to a side channel. The reader learns notification codes (OSC 9 / 99 / 777).
- Agent line in the pane row: name, status, current task — composed from existing widgets, theme-driven.
- Sounds on status changes, configurable per status (and per project).
- Status changes are events (DOM-shaped event system) and appear on the socket's event stream.

## Preserve
- Non-agent panes unchanged; process status stays separate from agent status.
- AGENTS.md § 0; nothing hard-coded.

## Done when
- Claude Code in a pane shows working → waiting → finished in its pane row and plays the configured sound; the same for Codex and pi; a test agent added through the contract (as a plugin would) works the same.

tasks.title: Claude Code, Codex and pi through the agent contract
tasks.description:
Depends on T171 (the contract). Read P102's description; hook facts in heca `agent-integration/agent-integration-plan.md` §2.

- **Claude Code:** hooks that print a notification escape code, added with `claude --settings <temp file>` so the user's own settings still load (hook lists add up across settings files). Map hook events to the status set.
- **Codex:** reads the notification codes Codex already prints (turn complete, permission) — no setup needed for the basic states.
- **pi:** a small extension heca ships, writing status to the side channel; installed once, never overwriting a user-changed copy.
Each is a built-in implementation of the same contract a plugin uses; nothing special-cased.

tasks.title: Sounds when an agent's status changes
tasks.description:
Depends on T171. Decision 19 in `~/projects/heca-pro/docs/decisions.md`.

Play a sound when an agent's status changes (not on every event). The audio runs on its own thread so the render loop never waits (`rodio` was the earlier choice — re-check). Configured in config.toml per status (enabled, volume, sound file), overridable per project (P101), off by default. Default sounds shipped. Sound is one channel of the notification settings per event (heca-pro decision 37) — build it so it fits that table, not as a separate system.
